sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Exception Handling - Exercises

This file contains 15 exercises to practice exception handling in Python.
Complete each exercise and test your solutions thoroughly.

Instructions:
- Read each exercise carefully
- Implement the required functionality with proper exception handling
- Test your solutions with various inputs
- Pay attention to the specific exceptions mentioned
